title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje tek Tirana Entry II
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament per shitje ne nje kompleks me cilesi te larte, ne faze te avancuar ndertimi, nga subjekti "Nova Construction 2012"
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin kater banim te objektit, me orientim perendim, ne nje nga godinat e kompleksit Tirana Entry II.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet, korridor shperndares dhe ballkon me dalje nga te dy ambjentet.
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Tirana Entry II
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale in a high-quality complex, in an advanced stage of construction, by the entity "Nova Construction 2012". The apartment is located on the fourth residential floor of the building, facing west, in one of the buildings of the Tirana Entry II complex. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet, a distribution corridor and a balcony with exits from both areas. For more information, contact me.
